question: Using the review's equation for diffusion time and Table 5's diffusivity for ZrO2, how long would a lithium ion take to cross a 10 nm ZrO2 coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%diffusion time%' OR text ILIKE '%ZrO%' OR text ILIKE '%τ%' OR text ILIKE '%tau%' OR text ILIKE '%=%' ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p14.T5' OR text ILIKE '%ZrO%' ORDER BY page, row_no, col_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page=12 AND id IN (SELECT id FROM lines WHERE page=12 AND line_no BETWEEN 30 AND 50) ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, kind, page, text, top FROM atoms WHERE page=12 AND top BETWEEN 300 AND 520 ORDER BY top
SELECT id, page, text, top, x0 FROM atoms WHERE page=12 AND top BETWEEN 60 AND 300 AND kind='line' ORDER BY top, x0
SELECT id, page, text, top, x0 FROM atoms WHERE page=13 AND top BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND kind='line' ORDER BY top, x0
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%nanomet%' ORDER BY page, top

WITH d AS (SELECT text FROM cells WHERE id='p14.T5.r13c2'),
l AS (SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L23')
SELECT regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM l), '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS l_nm,
       regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM d), '^([0-9.]+)', 1) AS D_mant,
       regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM d), '([0-9]+)$', 1) AS D_exp,
       CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM l), '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE) * 1e-7 AS l_cm_test

WITH v AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L23'), '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS l_nm,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM cells WHERE id='p14.T5.r13c2'), '^([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS d_mant,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM cells WHERE id='p14.T5.r13c2'), '([0-9]+)$', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS d_exp)
SELECT (l_nm*1e-7)^2 / (d_mant*POWER(10,-d_exp)) AS t_s,
 (l_nm*1e-7)^2 / (d_mant*POWER(10,-d_exp)) / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') AS t_h,
 (l_nm*1e-7)^2 / (d_mant*POWER(10,-d_exp)) / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.h_per_day') AS t_day
FROM v

WITH v AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p8.L23'), '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS l_nm, CAST(replace(replace(replace((SELECT text FROM cells WHERE id='p14.T5.r13c2'),' ',''),'×10^','e'),'−','-') AS DOUBLE) AS D_cm2s)
SELECT (l_nm/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / D_cm2s AS t_s,
(l_nm/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / D_cm2s / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') AS t_h,
(l_nm/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / D_cm2s / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.h_per_day') AS t_day, D_cm2s FROM v

SELECT (CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE)/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / CAST(replace(replace(replace(c.text,' ',''),'×10^','e'),'−','-') AS DOUBLE) AS t_s,
(CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE)/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / CAST(replace(replace(replace(c.text,' ',''),'×10^','e'),'−','-') AS DOUBLE) / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') AS t_h,
(CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '∼([0-9]+) nm', 1) AS DOUBLE)/((SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega')*(SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo'))*100)^2 / CAST(replace(replace(replace(c.text,' ',''),'×10^','e'),'−','-') AS DOUBLE) / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') / (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.h_per_day') AS t_day
FROM cells c, atoms a WHERE c.id='p14.T5.r13c2' AND a.id='p8.L23'

rendered: The review's diffusion-time equation is 𝑡 = 𝑙^2[1] over D, the lithium-ion diffusivity, where l is the diffusion length (the coating thickness). Table values of diffusivity are used for D, as the review states: taken from Table 5[2]. The diffusivity of ZrO2 in that table is 1.7 ×10^− 18[3] cm^2/s. For a coating of 10 nm[4], converting nm to cm and applying t = l^2/D gives a crossing time of about 588,235[5] seconds, which is about 163[6] hours, or about 6.8[7] days. This is a simple single-length estimate from the review's equation, so it is an order-of-magnitude figure rather than a measured value.
